According to the learned counsel for the applicants-petitioners, objections with respect to the previous report filed by the Local Commissioner, are pending adjudication before the trial Court.

Application stands disposed of.

The applicants-petitioners are exempted from filing the true typed translation of vernaculars in question annexed with the petition, at this stage, subject to filing of the same within seven days, as and when directed to do so.
Application stands disposed of.

opennyai_summary.decision:
No reply is intended to be filed on behalf of the non-applicant/petitioner.
For the reasons cited in the application, the same is allowed.
The amount lying deposited before the Registry of this Court is ordered to be released with proportionate interest accrued thereupon in favour of the applicant by remitting the same in his bank account, details whereof have been given in prayer clause of the application, subject to proper verification of his identity.
Application stands disposed of.
On taking steps within three days, issue notice to the sole-respondent, returnable within four weeks.
From a perusal of the impugned order dated 07.12.2024, it is evident that in the case at hand, trial Court has ordered appointment of Local Commissioner to carry on the demarcation of the suit land for the third time.
According to the learned counsel for the applicants-petitioners, objections with respect to the previous report filed by the Local Commissioner, are pending adjudication before the trial Court.
In view thereof, impugned order dated 07.12.2024, is stayed during the pendency of the present petition.
Application stands disposed of.
On taking steps within three days, issue notice to respondent No.1, returnable within four weeks.
The applicant-petitioner has preferred the present petition against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 10.07.2024, passed by learned Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1,
Mandi, District Mandi, H.P. (hereinafter referred to as 'the trial Court'), in Complaint Reg. No.906 of 2019, titled Ramesh Kumar Vs. Kishori Lal and affirmed by learned Sessions Judge, Kangra at Dharmashala, District Kangra, H.P. in Criminal Appeal No. 105 of 2024, titled Kishori Lal Vs.
Ramesh Kumar & Anr., decided on 12.12.2024.
Hence, the sentence in the case at hand, is ordered to be suspended, subject to the petitioner depositing 50% of the entire compensation amount, if not already deposited, before the trial Court within four weeks from today and also subject to his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, undertaking therein that petitioner will attend this Court as and when required and in case of dismissal of the revision petition, he will immediately surrender before the learned trial Court to receive the sentence.
A copy of this order be sent to the learned trial Court with the direction that the report of compliance of this order be submitted to this Court within a period of six weeks.
The application stands disposed of.
Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.
Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed as not pressed.
Status report be filed on or before the next date of hearing.
In view of the averments in the application and also the submissions made by learned counsel, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner- accused in this case, he shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bonds in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting Police Officer/Investigating Officer, subject to following conditions:-
(i) Petitioner, at the first instance, shall appear before the Investigating Officer, Police Station Khairi, District Chamba, H.P. on 10.01.2025, at 11.30 a.m;
(ii) Petitioner shall join the investigation of case as and when called for by the Investigating Officer in accordance with law;
(iii). Petitioner shall not hamper the investigation in any manner whatsoever;
(iv). Petitioner shall not contact the complainant, threaten or browbeat them or to use any pressure tactics in any manner whatsoever;
(v). Petitioner shall not leave India without prior permission of the Court;
(vi). Petitioner shall not make any inducement threat or promise, directly or indirectly, to the investigating officer or any person acquainted with the facts of the case to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any Police Officer or tamper with the evidence.
(Bipin C. Negi) Judge 09h January, 2025 (Gaurav Rawat) Rajinder Singh & Anr.
List the matter on 05.03.2025, on which date parties shall remain present.
Taking into account the fact that the matter inter se the parties stands compromised, further proceedings in Case No. Complaint IPC/Pvt. Complaint/10/2014, titled Vikram Vs. Rajinder & Anr.,
pending before the Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Amb, Una, are stayed.
Application stands disposed of.
The applicants-petitioners are exempted from filing the true typed translation of Annexure P-2 in question annexed with the petition, at this stage, subject to filing of the same within seven days, as and when directed to do so.
The sentence in the case at hand against the present petitioner is under Section 471, whereby he had been sentenced two years imprisonment and a fine of Rs.10,000/-.
In default of payment of fine, he has to further undergo imprisonment for six months.
On his death, the substantive sentence imposed goes, however, insofar as, the fine amount is concerned, proceedings in this respect can continue against the LRs.
For the bona fide reasons mentioned in the application, delay in bringing on record LRs of deceased sole respondent, is condoned.
Abatement, if any, is set aside.
Objections, if any,
be removed and the same be traced and placed on record well before the next date of hearing.
Non- bailable warrants for the arrest of the petitioner/accused, in the case at hand, have been issued for 09.01.2025.
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and is granted further time to comply with order dated 28.10.2024.
No reply is intended to be filed on behalf of the non-applicant/petitioner.
Non-applicant has no objection, if in case, money lying deposited in the Registry of this Court and the trial Court along with the proportionate interest accrued thereupon, be released in favour of the applicant.
Other than the aforesaid, for the reasons stated in the application i.e. since the parties are willing to settle the matter inter se and in this respect non-applicant has sought time to deposit the balance compensation amount, therefore, the amount lying deposited in the Registry of this Court and learned trial Court along with proportionate interest accrued thereupon, are ordered to be released in favour of the applicant by remitting the same in his bank account, details whereof have been given in para 5 of the application, subject to proper verification of his identity.
